# RCTD deconvolution -- composition figures + Python export

#===================================================================
# MERGE NOTE: combines two smaller figure scripts that shared an
# identical setup block (loading spe + RCTD_weights.Rds) -- kept once
# here instead of duplicated. Part A covers per-nerve/location
# composition and the enrichment heatmap; Part B is a separate
# extension analysis plotting 4 individual RCTD cell types directly
# (rather than grouped composites) at spot- and nerve-level.
#
# THIS SCRIPT ONLY GENERATES FIGURES (+ one data export) -- it reads
# the already-computed RCTD_weights.Rds and the frozen nerve
# identification columns (DE_SPE_annotaion.csv); it never recomputes
# RCTD or nerve identification. Safe to re-run as often as needed.
#
# WHAT THIS SCRIPT PRODUCES
# --------------------------
# Figures (output/06_deconvolution/figures/):
#   Part A:
#   - exploratory_Invaded_nerves_composition.pdf / exploratory_Noninvaded_nerves_composition.pdf
#       Per-nerve RCTD cell-type composition, stacked bars, split by
#       invasion status.
#   - exploratory_composition_inside_vs_proximal.pdf
#       Cell-type composition by location (Inside/Proximal) x invasion
#       status, horizontal stacked bars.
#   - exploratory_heatmap_deconvolution.pdf
#       Enrichment z-score heatmap: cell type x spatial category
#       (Invaded/NonInvaded nerve, tumor-distal, etc.).
#   Part B:
#   - exploratory_RCTD_immune_spot_level.pdf
#       The same 4 cell types per spot. NOT in the manuscript.
#   - Figure2F_RCTD_immune_nerve_level.pdf
#       Figure 2F. Myeloid / NK / CD8 T / B-plasma RCTD
#       proportions, aggregated to one mean value per nerve.
#
# Anything named "exploratory_" is not in the manuscript.
#
# Export (not a figure):
#   - clean_adata.h5ad (processed/)
#       spe exported for downstream Python analysis.
#===================================================================

```{r}
library(spacexr)
library(SpatialExperiment)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(zellkonverter)

# ---- 0. Directory structure -------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the project folder (the one containing input/).
# Run from there, or from scripts/ -- this moves up one level if needed.
if (basename(getwd()) == "scripts") setwd("..")
if (!dir.exists("input"))
  stop("Run this script from the project folder (the one containing input/).")

PROJECT_DIR   <- "."
INPUT_DIR     <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "input")
PROCESSED_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "processed")

ANALYSIS_NAME <- "05_RCTD"
FIGURES_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_DIR, "output", ANALYSIS_NAME, "figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

c25 <- c(
  "dodgerblue2", "#E31A1C", "green4", "#6A3D9A", "#FF7F00",
  "black", "gold1", "skyblue2", "#FB9A99", "palegreen2",
  "#CAB2D6", "#FDBF6F", "gray70", "khaki2",
  "maroon", "orchid1", "deeppink1", "blue1", "steelblue4",
  "darkturquoise", "green1", "yellow4", "yellow3",
  "darkorange4", "brown"
)

# ---- Frozen inputs: never recomputed here (shared by Parts A and B) ----
spe <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "Integrated_NMF.rds"))
colData(spe) <- DataFrame(read.csv(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "DE_SPE_annotaion.csv")))
colnames(spe) <- spe$barcode

W_df <- readRDS(file.path(INPUT_DIR, "RCTD_weights.Rds"))
```

```{r}
rename    <- dplyr::rename
count     <- dplyr::count
summarise <- dplyr::summarise
summarize <- dplyr::summarize
mutate    <- dplyr::mutate
arrange   <- dplyr::arrange
filter    <- dplyr::filter
select    <- dplyr::select
slice     <- dplyr::slice
pull      <- dplyr::pull

first     <- dplyr::first
```


## Part A -- per-nerve / per-location composition and enrichment heatmap

We map the colors for deconvolution and NMF to match the similar cell types.
```{r}
color_maping <- c( "Acinar" = "gold1",
                   "B_cells" = "maroon",
                   "Lymphocyte(CD4)" = "green4",
                   "Lymphocytes" = "green4",
                   "Myeloid(Macrophages)" = "#6A3D9A",
                   "Endothelial" = "#FF7F00",
                   "Endocrine" = "yellow4",
                   "Stellate" = "khaki2",
                   "CAF" = "skyblue2",
                   "Adipocytes" = "steelblue4",
                   "Lymphocyte(NK)" = "green2",
                   "Lymphocyte(CD8)" = "palegreen2",
                   "Myeloid" = "#CAB2D6",
                   "Schwann" = "#FDBF6F",
                   "Myeloid(C1q_macrophages)" = "#CAB2D6",
                   "Nerve" = "#FDBF6F",
                   "Muscle" = "orchid1",
                   "Ductal_malignant" = "gray70",
                   "Ductal_normal" = "black",
                   "B_cells_(Plasma cells)"  = "brown1")
```

# Per nerve average composition
Since we have so many good nerves, it is important to see the per nerve composition to see possible differences. The aim to see how similar the nerves are.

```{r}
nerve_ids <- DataFrame(
  barcode = spe$barcode,
  id=spe$NerveID,
  invasion = spe$Invaded,
  patient = spe$patient_id
)

W_nerve <-W_df
W_nerve$ID <- plyr::mapvalues(W_nerve$barcode, from = nerve_ids$barcode, to=nerve_ids$id)
W_nerve<- W_nerve %>% drop_na()
rownames(W_nerve) <- W_nerve$barcode
W_nerve$barcode <- NULL

cell_cols <- setdiff(names(W_nerve), "ID")

nerve_decon_w <- W_nerve %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(
    across(all_of(cell_cols), ~ mean(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nerve_decon_w_long <- nerve_decon_w %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cell_cols), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "mean_score") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(pct = if (sum(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) 0 else 100 * mean_score / sum(mean_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


nerve_decon_w_long$invasion <- plyr::mapvalues(nerve_decon_w_long$ID, from = nerve_ids$id, to=nerve_ids$invasion, warn_missing = FALSE)
nerve_decon_w_long$patient_id <- plyr::mapvalues(nerve_decon_w_long$ID, from = nerve_ids$id, to=nerve_ids$patient, warn_missing = FALSE)
```

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(nerve_decon_w_long[nerve_decon_w_long$invasion == 'Invaded',], aes(x = ID, y = pct, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.5, stat="identity",color = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_maping) +
  ggtitle("Invaded nerves deconvolution composition")+
  labs(x = "Nerve ID",
       y = "Composition") +
  facet_grid(~ patient_id, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x", labeller = as_labeller(c(
               "70865" = "Patient 3",
               "6249" = "Patient 2",
               "54703" = "Patient 1"))) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_Invaded_nerves_composition.pdf"), p1, width = 14, height = 10)
p1
```

# Visualization of composition
Now that we have the weights, we want to visualize the composition of the important categories that we care about.
```{r}
inv_nerve_barcodes <- spe[, !is.na(colData(spe)$Invaded) & colData(spe)$Invaded == "Invaded"]$barcode
non_inv_nerve_barcodes <- spe[, !is.na(colData(spe)$Invaded) & colData(spe)$Invaded == "NonInvaded"]$barcode
surr_inv_nerve_barcodes <- spe[, !is.na(colData(spe)$invasion) & colData(spe)$invasion == "Surr_Invaded"]$barcode
surr_non_inv_nerve_barcodes <- spe[, !is.na(colData(spe)$invasion) & colData(spe)$invasion == "Surr_NonInvaded"]$barcode


Avrg_inv <- W_df |>
  filter(barcode %in% inv_nerve_barcodes) |>
  select(-barcode) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "mean") |>
  filter(mean > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(mean)) |>
  mutate(pct = mean / sum(mean),
         Categ = "Invaded", location = "Inside")

Avrg_non_inv <- W_df |>
  filter(barcode %in% non_inv_nerve_barcodes) |>
  select(-barcode) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "mean") |>
  filter(mean > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(mean)) |>
  mutate(pct = mean / sum(mean),
         Categ = "NonInvaded", location = "Inside")

Avrg_surr_inv <- W_df |>
  filter(barcode %in% surr_inv_nerve_barcodes) |>
  select(-barcode) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "mean") |>
  filter(mean > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(mean)) |>
  mutate(pct = mean / sum(mean),
         Categ = "Invaded", location = "Proximal")

Avrg_surr_non_inv <- W_df |>
  filter(barcode %in% surr_non_inv_nerve_barcodes) |>
  select(-barcode) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::as_tibble() |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "mean") |>
  filter(mean > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(mean)) |>
  mutate(pct = mean / sum(mean),
         Categ = "NonInvaded", location = "Proximal")

compos <- rbind(Avrg_inv,Avrg_non_inv,Avrg_surr_inv,Avrg_surr_non_inv)
```


```{r}
p3 <- ggplot(compos, aes(y = location, x = pct, fill = cell_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) x * 100,
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  scale_fill_manual("Cell type", values = color_maping) +
  facet_grid(Categ ~ ., switch = "y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y.left  = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 20, 10)
  )
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_composition_inside_vs_proximal.pdf"), p3, width = 8, height = 4)
p3
```

# Heatmap with z-scores
Now that we have the cell type information, we want to see the contribution of the different cell types in our categories.
```{r}
sub_spe <- spe[, colData(spe)$invasion != "other" ] #to have more clear results

W_df_heatmap <- W_df
rownames(W_df_heatmap) <- W_df_heatmap$barcode
W_df_heatmap$barcode <- NULL

sub_w <- W_df_heatmap[rownames(W_df_heatmap) %in% sub_spe$barcode, , drop = TRUE]

categories <- data.frame(
  barcodes = as.character(colData(sub_spe)[, "barcode"]),
  category = as.character(colData(sub_spe)[, "invasion"]))
cats <- unique(categories$category)
cell_types <- colnames(W_df_heatmap)

# ---- Function for enrichment z-score ----
enrichment_z <- function(vec, group, target_cat) {
  bcs_in  <- group$barcodes[group$category == target_cat]
  x_in  <- vec[bcs_in]
  mu_in <- mean(x_in,  na.rm = TRUE)
  mu_all<- mean(vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  (mu_in - mu_all) / sd(vec)
}

```

```{r}
z_mat <- sapply(cell_types, function(ct) {
 v <- setNames(sub_w[, ct], rownames(sub_w))
  sapply(cats, function(ca) enrichment_z(v, categories, ca))
})
rownames(z_mat) <- cats
rownames(z_mat) <- dplyr::recode(rownames(z_mat),
                                 "Surr_Invaded" = "Invaded nerve proximal",
                                 "Nerve" = "Non-invaded nerve",
                                 "Surr_NonInvaded" = "Non-invaded nerve proximal",
                                 "InvadedNerve" = "Invaded nerve",
                                 "TumorDistal" = "Tumor Distal")
colnames(z_mat) <- gsub("_", " ", colnames(z_mat))

p4 <- pheatmap(z_mat,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         scale = "none",
         color = colorRampPalette(c(c25[1], "white", c25[2]))(100),
         fontsize_number = 10)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_heatmap_deconvolution.pdf"), p4, width = 12, height = 6)
p4
```

## Part B -- 4 selected RCTD cell types (separate extension analysis)

This part plots 4 individual RCTD cell types directly (Myeloid, NK, CD8, B/plasma cells), at both spot level and nerve level, using the finer 3-category scheme (Adjacent / Diseased-NonInvaded / Invaded) rather than the 2-way Invaded/NonInvaded split used in Part A above.

```{r}
#==========================================
# Identify nerve spots and define groups (3-category scheme)
#==========================================

nerve_mask <- colData(spe)$is.nerve == TRUE

nerve_meta_df <- data.frame(
  barcode     = as.character(spe$barcode[nerve_mask]),
  patient_id  = as.factor(colData(spe)$patient_id[nerve_mask]),
  NerveID     = as.factor(colData(spe)$NerveID[nerve_mask]),
  Invaded     = as.character(colData(spe)$Invaded[nerve_mask]),
  type_raw    = as.character(colData(spe)$type[nerve_mask])
)

nerve_meta_df$types_grouped <- ifelse(nerve_meta_df$type_raw == "noPNI", "Adjacent", "Diseased")
nerve_meta_df$nerve_category <- ifelse(
  nerve_meta_df$Invaded == "NonInvaded",
  paste0("NonInvaded_", nerve_meta_df$types_grouped),
  nerve_meta_df$Invaded
)
nerve_meta_df <- nerve_meta_df[!is.na(nerve_meta_df$nerve_category), ]

analysis_df <- nerve_meta_df %>%
  left_join(W_df, by = "barcode")
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# Set plotting order and labels
#=====================================================

nerve_order <- c("NonInvaded_Adjacent", "NonInvaded_Diseased", "Invaded")
patient_order <- c("54703", "6249", "70865")

rctd_selected_cols <- c(
  "Myeloid",
  "Lymphocyte(NK)",
  "Lymphocyte(CD8)",
  "B_cells_(Plasma_cells)"
)

rctd_labels <- c(
  "Myeloid"                = "Myeloid",
  "Lymphocyte(NK)"         = "NK lymphocytes",
  "Lymphocyte(CD8)"        = "CD8 T cells",
  "B_cells_(Plasma_cells)" = "B/plasma cells"
)
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# Prepare spot-level RCTD table, aggregate to nerve level
#=====================================================

rctd_spot_long <- analysis_df %>%
  dplyr::select(barcode, patient_id, NerveID, nerve_category, dplyr::all_of(rctd_selected_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    barcode = as.character(barcode),
    NerveID = as.character(NerveID),
    patient_id = factor(as.character(patient_id), levels = patient_order),
    nerve_category = factor(as.character(nerve_category), levels = nerve_order)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(rctd_selected_cols), names_to = "CellType", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    CellType = factor(CellType, levels = rctd_selected_cols),
    CellTypeLabel = factor(rctd_labels[as.character(CellType)], levels = unname(rctd_labels[rctd_selected_cols]))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(nerve_category), !is.na(NerveID), !is.na(Proportion))

rctd_nerve_long <- rctd_spot_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(NerveID, patient_id, nerve_category, CellType, CellTypeLabel) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(MeanProportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE), n_spots = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    nerve_category = factor(nerve_category, levels = nerve_order),
    patient_id = factor(patient_id, levels = patient_order)
  )
```

```{r}
#=====================================================
# Plot spot-level and nerve-level RCTD proportions
#=====================================================

base_size <- 11
panel_aspect <- 0.5

p_rctd_spot <- ggplot(rctd_spot_long, aes(x = nerve_category, y = Proportion)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", color = NA, alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = patient_id), width = 0.10, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ CellTypeLabel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = panel_aspect,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = base_size * 0.85),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing = unit(6, "pt")
  ) +
  ylab("RCTD proportion per spot") +
  xlab("Nerve category") +
  labs(color = "Patient ID")

p_rctd_spot

p_rctd_nerve <- ggplot(rctd_nerve_long, aes(x = nerve_category, y = MeanProportion)) +
  geom_violin(fill = "grey85", color = NA, alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.25, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = patient_id), width = 0.10, size = 0.9, alpha = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ CellTypeLabel, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = panel_aspect,
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = base_size * 0.85),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing = unit(6, "pt")
  ) +
  ylab("Mean RCTD proportion per nerve") +
  xlab("Nerve category") +
  labs(color = "Patient ID")

p_rctd_nerve

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "exploratory_RCTD_immune_spot_level.pdf"), p_rctd_spot, width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 600, useDingbats = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "Figure2F_RCTD_immune_nerve_level.pdf"), p_rctd_nerve, width = 7, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 600, useDingbats = FALSE)
```
